MESSAGES.REGISTER_START:
Hello user!

Before we start the registration process, I'd like to know in which language you prefer to communicate with me.

Please note that this choice will affect our further communication. After registration, your profile will indicate that you speak this language.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_START_FAILURE: You haven't selected a language for communication!
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_1:
Thank you! Now I can speak with you in your preferred language.

My name is CRM BOT, I assist in matters of our blood organization. To use me, you need to register an account. Your data will be kept confidential, and things like passwords will be encrypted and never shared. Let's start the registration process!

First step. Send me your Telegram contact, so we can speed up the registration process significantly.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_1_FAILURE: This is not your contact! Please press the button below.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_2: Second step. Enter your date of birth in the format DD-MM-YYYY. You'll have another attempt in case of a mistake.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_2_FAILURE: Incorrect date of birth! It must be written in the format DD-MM-YYYY.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_3_FAILURE: Incorrect gender selected! Please choose one of the options above.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_4: Fourth step. Enter your email in the format mail@mail.com
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_4_FAILURE: Email entered in incorrect format! Please write it as mail@mail.com.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_5:
Fifth step. Enter the password for your future account. The password will not be shared anywhere and will be encrypted.

The password must consist of numbers, uppercase and lowercase letters of the Latin alphabet. The use of special characters, except underscore, is prohibited.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_5_FAILURE: The password does not meet the requirements! Please create a password that meets the requirements above.
MESSAGES.SUCCESSFULL_REGISTER: Great! We have registered you in the system, now you can use all the functionality!
MESSAGES.ALREADY_REGISTERED: You are already registered in the system!
